description: Retrieves the version history for a Figma file or branch, as specified by its `file_key`.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving the version history of a Figma file.

after.description: Version ID for pagination; retrieves versions created strictly after this ID.
after.title: After

before.description: Version ID for pagination; retrieves versions created strictly before this ID.
before.title: Before

file_key.description: The key of the Figma file or branch from which to retrieve the version history. Extract from file URL: https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/... For branch keys, use `GET /v1/files/:key` with the `branch_data` query param to obtain it. The authenticated user must have access to the file; otherwise a 404 'Not found' error is returned.
file_key.title: File Key

page_size.description: Number of version items per page. The API defaults to 30 if this parameter is not sent.
page_size.title: Page Size

inputSchema.title: GetVersionsOfAFileRequest

name: get_versions_of_a_file

GetVersionsOfAFileResponse.description: Response schema containing the version history of the specified Figma file.

pagination.description: Pagination details with URLs for next/previous pages.
pagination.title: Pagination

versions.description: A list containing the file version objects.
versions.title: Versions

GetVersionsOfAFileResponse.title: GetVersionsOfAFileResponse

next_page.description: URL to retrieve the next page of version results.
next_page.title: Next Page

prev_page.description: URL to retrieve the previous page of version results.
prev_page.title: Prev Page

handle.description: The display name or handle of the user.
handle.title: Handle

id.description: The unique and stable identifier for the user.
id.title: Id

img_url.description: The URL for the user's profile image.
img_url.title: Img Url

created_at.description: The timestamp in UTC ISO 8601 format indicating when this version was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: Description entered in the Figma editor for this version.
description.title: Description

id.description: The unique identifier for this specific file version.
id.title: Id

label.description: Label assigned in the Figma editor for this version.
label.title: Label

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a thumbnail image of this file version.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

user.description: Details of the user who created this version.
user.title: User
